description: Bundles a harmless variable rename (total -> running_total) together with a real off-by-one bug (range(len(items)) -> range(len(items) - 1)) in the same hunk. Calibrates whether the reviewer attributes the finding to the actual defect line rather than the cosmetic rename, and whether it correctly abstains on the sibling clean diff.

findings.summary: Off-by-one loop bound drops the last item from the total price computation
findings.evidence: range(len(self.items)) was narrowed to range(len(self.items) - 1), so total_price() silently omits the final item in self.items.
